Author: Hangovers
Name: StreamerMode
Punchline: One command to hide every plugin & Dalamud UI element.
Description: Hides all plugin windows, all Dalamud windows (settings, installer, log, console, dev menu, title-screen badges) and the Dalamud entries in the system (Escape) menu with a single slash command — controllable ONLY via chat, so nothing on screen reveals you are running plugins. While active it also skips the entire per-frame UI build, reducing the CPU load Dalamud adds. Usage: /streamer (toggle) | /streamer on | /streamer off | /streamer status
